verdict.rationale: Plausible's single script captures pageviews automatically, including SPA pushState and hash routing. It also automatically tracks file downloads, form completions, external link clicks and scroll depth, with no per-event code required. Missing for 10: no evidence of automatic capture of arbitrary in-page/button clicks (only outbound links and downloads), no detail on how form tracking works or what it covers, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the auto-tracking.
